finalText:
**Real scope is 94 files and about 1080 lines. Most of it must not be renamed.**

| Area | Files | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| JS locals in `services/**` | 75 | Yes |
| SQL strings in the same repo files | 75 | No. Column stays `account_id` |
| `migrations/` | 12 | No. Applied history, breaks the down step |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | No. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| `docs/openapi.yaml`, `lib/audit.js` | 2 | No. Frozen public contract |

In [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) only the left key may move. The right key `account_id` is the wire name.

So the safe rename is local variables alone. Every file it touches also holds a name that must stay.
